.cursor-sunlight{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:740px;height:740px;z-index:18;pointer-events:none;user-select:none;mix-blend-mode:screen;opacity:0;transform:translate3d(-1500px,-1500px,0);transition:opacity .65s ease;contain:layout style;will-change:transform;isolation:isolate}
.cursor-sunlight.is-visible{opacity:1}
.cursor-sunlight::before,.cursor-sunlight::after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none}
.cursor-sunlight::before{inset:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,244,211,.15) 0%,rgba(255,226,166,.095) 16%,rgba(249,205,126,.045) 36%,rgba(247,211,147,.014) 55%,transparent 72%)}
.cursor-sunlight::after{width:220px;height:680px;left:260px;top:-65px;transform:rotate(-32deg);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,246,218,.055),rgba(255,222,165,.025) 35%,transparent 69%);filter:blur(22px)}
body.chinese .cursor-sunlight::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,244,216,.13) 0%,rgba(245,224,178,.08) 18%,rgba(233,205,148,.035) 38%,transparent 72%)}
body.still .cursor-sunlight{display:none}
